caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) across varying ratios of activated parameters measured in percentage. The x-axis is labeled as "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" with a linear scale from 11.5 to 14.0 and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. There are four lines representing different methods. The red dashed line labeled "Transformer" remains horizontal across the x-axis at a PPL of approximately 11.6. The gray line with square markers for "Only MoHD FFN" starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.3 at 50%, then rises again to approximately 11.75 at 25%. The purple line with circle markers for "Only MoHD ATTN" starts at about 11.5, rises significantly to around 14.5 at 25%. The blue line with cross markers for "MoHD ATTN + MLP" begins at 11.5 and follows an upward trend to approximately 13.3 at 25%. A legend is placed at the top left corner of the plot.
